explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes passive funds as schemes that aim to mirror a particular benchmark index, typically with low costs and low tracking error, rather than relying on stock-selection skill. The Trap: Active funds use discretion to deviate from the benchmark and are the conceptual opposite of passive funds; "random stocks" and "only sectoral" mischaracterise the rule-based, index-tracking nature of passive investing. Note: Passive funds are evaluated primarily on cost and tracking error against the chosen index rather than on alpha; verify the specific benchmark and methodology before treating any fund as truly passive.
